subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Switches and Relays
description: A 60-second lesson on Switches and Relays.

hook.text: A switch is the simplest circuit component — open means off, closed means on.

buildup.text: Mechanical switches use metal contacts that physically touch or separate.

discovery.text: A relay is a switch controlled by another circuit — a small signal controls big power.

twist.text: Early computers used thousands of relays. Each click was a logic operation.

climax.text: Transistors replaced relays — smaller, faster, no moving parts to wear out.

punchline.text: On or off — every digital device starts with a switch.

quiz.question: What does a relay allow in a circuit?
options: It converts AC to DC power
A small signal controls a switch that handles much larger power
It stores energy in a magnetic field for later use
